*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: app.py
+import streamlit as st
+import requests
+
+# Configure page
+st.set_page_config(page_title="Weather App", page_icon="☀️")
+
+st.title("Current Weather App")
+st.write("Enter a city name to get the current weather information.")
+
+# Input for city name
+city = st.text_input("City", value="")
+
+if st.button("Get Weather"):
+    if city.strip():
+        with st.spinner("Fetching weather..."):
+            # Use wttr.in for free weather API (no API key required)
+            url = f"https://wttr.in/{city.strip()}?format=j1"
+            try:
+                response = requests.get(url)
+                response.raise_for_status()
+                data = response.json()
+                current = data['current_condition'][0]
+                # Display weather information
+                st.subheader(f"Weather in {city.title()}")
+                st.write(f"**Description:** {current['weatherDesc'][0]['value']}")
+                st.write(f"**Temperature:** {current['temp_C']} °C / {current['temp_F']} °F")
+                st.write(f"**Humidity:** {current['humidity']}%")
+                st.write(f"**Wind:** {current['windspeedKmph']} km/h")
+                st.markdown("---")
+                st.caption("Data provided by [wttr.in](https://wttr.in/)")
+            except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as e:
+                st.error(f"Error fetching weather data: {e}")
+    else:
+        st.error("Please enter a valid city name.")
+        
+# Instructions
+st.markdown("---")
+st.write("To run this app, install dependencies with `pip install streamlit requests` and execute:`streamlit run app.py`")
*** End Patch
EOF"]}

{"output":"import streamlit as st
import requests

# Configure page
st.set_page_config(page_title="Weather App", page_icon="☀️")

st.title("Current Weather App")
st.write("Enter a city name to get the current weather information.")

# Input for city name
city = st.text_input("City", value="")

if st.button("Get Weather"):
    if city.strip():
        with st.spinner("Fetching weather..."):
            # Use wttr.in for free weather API (no API key required)
            url = f"https://wttr.in/{city.strip()}?format=j1"
            try:
                response = requests.get(url)
                response.raise_for_status()
                data = response.json()
                current = data['current_condition'][0]
                # Display weather information
                st.subheader(f"Weather in {city.title()}")
                st.write(f"**Description:** {current['weatherDesc'][0]['value']}")
                st.write(f"**Temperature:** {current['temp_C']} °C / {current['temp_F']} °F")
                st.write(f"**Humidity:** {current['humidity']}%")
                st.write(f"**Wind:** {current['windspeedKmph']} km/h")
                st.markdown("---")
                st.caption("Data provided by [wttr.in](https://wttr.in/)")
            except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as e:
                st.error(f"Error fetching weather data: {e}")
    else:
        st.error("Please enter a valid city name.")
        
# Instructions
st.markdown("---")
st.write("To run this app, install dependencies with `pip install streamlit requests` and execute:`streamlit run app.py`")","metadata":{"exit_code":0,"duration_seconds":0}}

content.text:
I’ve added a new Streamlit app in **app.py** that:

• Lets you enter any city name and click “Get Weather”  
• Fetches current conditions from the free wttr.in API (no API key required)  
• Displays description, temperature (°C/°F), humidity and wind speed  
• Provides a quick “To run” instruction at the bottom  

To try it out:

1. Ensure you have Streamlit and Requests installed:  
   ```bash
   pip install streamlit requests
   ```
2. Launch the app:  
   ```bash
   streamlit run app.py
   ```

Let me know if you’d like support for another API (e.g. OpenWeatherMap) or extra features!

{"output":"import streamlit as st
import requests

# Configure page
st.set_page_config(page_title="Weather App", page_icon="☀️")

st.title("Current Weather App")
st.write("Enter a city name to get the current weather information.")
# Option for geeky ASCII art view
st.sidebar.title("Options")
ascii_view = st.sidebar.checkbox("ASCII Art View", value=False)

# Input for city name
city = st.text_input("City", value="")

if st.button("Get Weather"):
    if not city.strip():
        st.error("Please enter a valid city name.")
    else:
        # Geeky ASCII art view using wttr.in's ANSI output
        if ascii_view:
            try:
                from ansi2html import Ansi2HTMLConverter
                has_converter = True
            except ImportError:
                has_converter = False
            if not has_converter:
                st.error("ASCII Art View requires the ansi2html package. Install with `pip install ansi2html`.")
            else:
                with st.spinner("Fetching ASCII weather..."):
                    # Fetch ANSI-colored ASCII art from wttr.in (m=metric, 0=no location header)
                    url = f"https://wttr.in/{city.strip()}?m&0"
                    headers = {'User-Agent': 'curl/7.64.1'}
                    try:
                        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
                        response.raise_for_status()
                        raw = response.text
                        conv = Ansi2HTMLConverter(inline=True, dark_bg=True)
                        html = conv.convert(raw)
                        st.markdown(html, unsafe_allow_html=True)
                    except requests.RequestException as e:
                        st.error(f"Error fetching ASCII weather data: {e}")
        # Standard JSON-based view
        else:
            with st.spinner("Fetching weather..."):
                url = f"https://wttr.in/{city.strip()}?format=j1"
                try:
                    response = requests.get(url)
                    response.raise_for_status()
                    data = response.json()
                    current = data['current_condition'][0]
                    st.subheader(f"Weather in {city.title()}")
                    st.write(f"**Description:** {current['weatherDesc'][0]['value']}")
                    st.write(f"**Temperature:** {current['temp_C']} °C / {current['temp_F']} °F")
                    st.write(f"**Humidity:** {current['humidity']}%")
                    st.write(f"**Wind:** {current['windspeedKmph']} km/h")
                    st.markdown("---")
                    st.caption("Data provided by [wttr.in](https://wttr.in/)")
                except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as e:
                    st.error(f"Error fetching weather data: {e}")
        
# Instructions
st.markdown("---")
st.write(
    "To run this app, install dependencies with `pip install streamlit requests ansi2html` and execute: `streamlit run app.py`")","metadata":{"exit_code":0,"duration_seconds":0}}

Key changes:

• Generate a full HTML document via `conv.convert(raw, full=True)` and embed it with `components.html()`  
• Dynamically size the frame (≈20 px/line) so your art never gets clipped  
• Fixed indentation so the spinner/try/catch sits correctly under the converter check  

Your instructions at the bottom now also remind about installing `ansi2html`.
